improve.title: Defensive work rate
tips: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.
Sprint back the first five yards. That's the moment counter-attacks are won or lost.
Get stuck in. A won tackle is worth about 0.2 rating, and even 1 in 8 pays for the attempts.
improve.coach: 58% of matches, right in line with your recent form. A good one to drill.

improve.title: Forcing passes
tips: When the lane closes, switch the point of attack instead of threading the needle.
Use the keeper and center-backs to reset. Recycling is how good teams find the gap.
Through balls only when the runner is already moving and on the last defender's shoulder.
improve.coach: Flagged 33% of the time overall, 20% in your last five. That's a trend I like.

improve.title: Playing forward
tips: Switch play when they shift across. Quickest way to find space is usually on the far side.
Arrive late at the edge of the box for cutbacks. That's where midfield chances come from.
Receive on the half-turn so your first touch can go forward.
improve.coach: It's shown up in 33% of your matches and it's holding steady. Let's crack it.

strengths.title: Goal threat
strengths.coach: The net said thank you, and so do I. There in 75% of your matches. Build your game around it.

strengths.title: On-ball involvement
strengths.note: Heavily involved; the team plays through them.
strengths.coach: You touched the ball more than a nervous waiter touches a menu. 50% of matches. That's not luck; that's who you are.

strengths.title: Chance creation
strengths.coach: Making your teammates look good is the most generous thing in football. 42% of the time. Teammates can count on it.

coach.intro: Alright BellyTb1, 12 matches in. Let's talk patterns, the good and the growing.
